snippet.title: Liminal: Skies - Official Announcement Teaser Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Welcome to Liminal: Skies, the opening chapter of a new creative universe. More than just town building, here you can design your own characters, bring them to life with dialogue, and craft entire worlds through play. Share your stories with friends or explore adventures made by others. With Liminal, creation is the game. Check out the Liminal Skies announcement teaser trailer for a glimpse at what you can expect from this upcoming game. Liminal Skies will be available on PC.
